# dsh-panel-collapse

A tiny DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds one button to the
sidebar footer, next to the settings cont

rol, which collapses or expands the **global panel
list** (Plugins, Scheduled tasks, Context insight

, Memory, … and any other plugin that
registers a sidebar panel).

Collapsing frees the vertical space the panel rows occupy, so the workspace and session list
gets mo
re room. The state is remembered per browser profile and survives restarts.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Restart the app afterwards — DeepSeek Harness only loads a new client module generation on
startup,
so the button will not appear until you relaunch.
### From source
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`link:` makes the profile point at the clone instead of copying it, so `git pull` is enough to
updat
e and there is nothing to reinstall.
To remove it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`--profile` must come immediately after `plugin`; `dsh plugin add x --profile y` is rejected
with `r
equired option '--profile' not specified`.
## Usage
The button sits in the sidebar footer, to the right of the existing icon buttons.

- **Expanded** (default) — shows a "collapse" chevron pair; clicking hides the panel list.
- **Colla

psed** — shows an "expand" chevron pair; clicking brings the list back.
- In the collapsed (rail) si

debar the button grows to 36×36 to match the host's rail buttons.
- The current state is stored in `
localStorage` under `dsh.panel-collapse.collapsed`.
## How it works

The plugin is a client-side bundle only — `index.js` is an empty host half, all the work
happens in
`client.js`, which the app loads lazily via `window.__ModuleLoader__`.

1. `apply(ctx)` registers the `panel-collapse` locale namespace (`zh`, `en`) as a context
effect, so

the dictionary is disposed when the plugin unloads.
2. It registers one entry in the `sidebar.foote

r.action` list slot with `id: "panel-collapse"`
and `order: 40`, which puts it after the built-in Co

rdis panel button.
3. The component keeps a boolean in `React.useState`, mirrored into `localStorage

`, and
renders a `<style>` element while collapsed:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The first selector is the locale-independent one: every panel row hosts a
`sidebar.panellist` outlet

, so the `nav` that contains them is exactly the panel group.
The other two are a fallback that keys
off the host's own accessible names.

No host code is imported, patched or monkey-patched. The button reuses only the public
`--dsw-alias-

*` / `--dsw-radius-*` / `--dsw-focus-ring-*` theme tokens, so it follows the
light and dark themes a
nd the sidebar's wide/collapsed states.
## Compatibility

| DeepSeek Harness | `>=0.2.0-rc.2` |
| Client slots used | `sidebar.footer.action` (list) |
| Runti
me dependencies | none (React is taken from the app's module table) |
## Development
The package is plain ESM with no build step. `client.js` is the shipped artifact.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`scripts/verify.mjs` also checks the install state when the package is linked into a profile
(`node_

modules/<name>` + `dsh.profile.bundles`); it skips those checks otherwise. Set
`DSH_PROFILE_DIR` to
point it at a non-default profile.

These scripts are static checks. They do not prove the button looks right on screen — that
still nee
ds a human looking at the running app.
### Local iteration
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`link:` makes the profile point at this directory instead of copying it, so edits to
`client.js` tak
e effect on the next app restart without reinstalling.
## Known limitations

- The panel group is hidden with CSS, so the host still believes the panels are mounted. That
is int

entional — it keeps the toggle independent of host internals and reversible without a
reload — but i

t means the collapse is purely visual.
- The `:has()` selector requires a reasonably modern Chromium

, which the desktop app is built
on. The two `aria-label` fallbacks do not depend on it.
- Collapsin

g hides *all* rows of the panel list, including rows added by other plugins. That
is the point of th
e feature; there is no per-row filtering.
